title: ROS 2 nodes
keywords: node nodes ros2 node list info name unique graph participant process
text: A node is one participant in the ROS graph; a process can hold one or more nodes. Nodes talk through topics, services, actions and parameters. ros2 node list shows the running nodes and ros2 node info /name lists a node's publishers, subscribers, services and actions. Node names must be unique: two nodes with the same name cause warnings and confuse tools. A node missing from ros2 node list usually runs with a different ROS_DOMAIN_ID or RMW, or discovery cannot reach it.
